message.reasoning_content:
I am acting as VP of Finance to evaluate whether to pay this vendor invoice.

Reviewing the payment policy. A "reject" finding blocks payment automatically. Warnings and info findings do not block payment on their own. I must weigh them carefully. Invoices over $10,000 require explicit scrutiny of every finding and the risk memo. I will reject this invoice because the stock discrepancy is a "reject" finding.

The memo is medium severity. It does not override a clean vendor record on its own. I will cite the finding IDs in my reasons and list every finding considered.

WidgetB also exceeds stock by five units. The total mismatch is confirmed: line items plus tax equal $15,635, but the invoice total is $15,525.
